items.notes: Tenant isolation surfaces (routing, credentials, cache/queue keys, quotas) bear on the move, but migration coordination is not described.
Says to bind the key to immutable request parameters and reject same-key/different-intent reuse.
Explains that agreement on scheduler state does not prove the external effect occurred; launch identity and reconciliation are required.
Distinguishes HTTP method semantics from business-effect deduplication; background only, no dedup-key expiry test.
Compares logical, physical and WAL backup methods; does not define or distinguish RPO and RTO.
Defines RPO/RTO measurement and notes lagging replicas; promotion and deletion recovery are not addressed in the excerpt.
Calls a WAL archive insufficient by itself for PITR, but does not list the required restore artifacts.
Diagnostic experiment table for CPU, pool, GC and memory; unrelated to fan-out latency thresholds.
Worked retain/hedge/split decision covers hedging tradeoffs and admission, but not when hedging adds overload.
Explains closed-loop feedback waiting on prior iterations and names the coordinated-omission distortion.
